notes: Individual images are named by pose and expression. Original singles retain their exact file bytes. Collages are archived in originals/. Crops preserve source RGBA pixels without resizing and mask neighboring poses. Touching cutouts are separated along their narrowest boundary. Crop boxes use Pillow coordinates [left, top, right, bottom]. Numeric suffixes distinguish variants of the same pose.
